hello every one

i want to download the summary results of my data:
in ui.r
tabPanel(title="File Summary",verbatimTextOutput("summa"),
                 div(
                   downloadButton(outputId="downloadSummary", label="Download results", class="btn btn-primary")  
                   )
                 )

in the server.r code i have:

################## Summary Tab ##################
    output$summa <- renderPrint({      
      summary(as.numeric(datasetinput()$value))
    })
    output$downloadSummary <- downloadHandler(      
        filename = function(){paste('summary', Sys.Date(), '.csv')} ,
        content = function(file){
          write.csv(t(as.matrix(summary(as.numeric(datasetinput()$value)))), file, row.names=FALSE)
        }
      )
#################################################
if i have not a data and i click the button it works and download a file like this,
Min.,"1stQu.","Median","Mean","3rdQu.","Max."
NA,NA,NA,NA,NA,NA
i want to test if there an input file or not, where i can do that ???

or how i cant i use javascript to check that and send a message to the user telling him that there is no data loaded ???
datasetinput = reactive({
    inFile <- input$file1
    if (is.null(inFile))
{
      return(NULL)
    }else
{
      data <- read.csv(inFile$datapath, header=input$header, sep=input$sep, quote=input$quote, row.names=NULL)
    }
  })  

when i check that inFile is not null in downloadHandler it does not work ?? 

thanks for your aide

Alex

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: downloadHandler
parts:
I think it'd be better to put the downloadButton inside a conditionalPanel(). You'd think you could use "input.file1" as the condition, but for not very good reasons file inputs aren't available for use in conditionalPanel conditions.

What you can do as a workaround is define an output in server.R that you can use in a condition:

output$hasFile <- reactive( !is.null(input$file1) )
outputOptions(output, "hasFile", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

Then in the conditionalPanel your condition would be "output.hasFile".
